# Michael Azazi Real Estate

> REALTOR® with eXp Realty, serving the Charlotte Metro area (North Carolina & South Carolina). Buyer, seller, and investor representation. Certified Probate Expert (CPE), focused on probate, inherited, and distressed property sales.

## Credentials
- Licensed REALTOR® in North Carolina and South Carolina
- Brokered by eXp Realty
- RENE (Real Estate Negotiation Expert)
- CPE (Certified Probate Expert)
- CLS (Certified Listing Specialist), certified through Brandon Mulrenin's Reverse Selling methodology

## Background
Michael's foundation in real estate began in 2015 managing properties (primarily parking operations), which shaped his eye for detail and proactive communication. He became a REALTOR® in 2023, working on teams through 2025, before going independent in December 2025.

## Services
- Seller representation across the Charlotte Metro area
- Buyer representation across the Charlotte Metro area
- Investor and investment property transactions
- Probate and estate property sales
- Distressed property sales
- Free home valuations
- Free buyer/seller consultations (see /schedule)

## Probate and inherited property
Michael is a Certified Probate Expert (CPE) who helps personal representatives, executors, and heirs sell inherited and estate homes in the Charlotte Metro area, working alongside the estate attorney. Licensed in both North Carolina (estates handled by the Clerk of Superior Court) and South Carolina (county Probate Court), so one agent can handle estate property on both sides of the state line. Full guide: https://azazirealestate.com/probate

## Service area
Charlotte, NC and the surrounding Charlotte Metro region, including parts of North Carolina and South Carolina.

5.0 average rating across verified client reviews from buyers and sellers (see homepage for full reviews).
